subject: Sponsor healthcheck & SLA clarification — MAP actions and owners
messages:
From: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@fastbank.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@fastbank.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — urgent clarification on SLA / priority support

Michael / Monica —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. One immediate ask from our side: the procurement and ops teams flagged a gap in the SLA appendix around priority support hours during our last-mile testing window. FastBank requires a written exception or an alternate support commitment for the 48-hour critical window before go-live.

We attached our suggested redline for the SLA appendix (FastBank_SLA_Redline_v1.pdf). Can Redwood commit to either: (A) 24x7 enclosed critical response for the 48-hour window, or (B) an on-call engineering rotation with a guaranteed 1-hour acknowledge and 4-hour response?

This affects our MAP close timeline — we may need a prioritized rollback plan if we don’t get a written commitment. Our executive sponsor (me) will need a brief for next Thursday’s steering committee.

Next steps requested:
- Confirmation of which option you can accept
- Owner & contact for on-call (if option B)
- Updated MAP milestone for go-live if we need a contingency

Attaching FastBank_SLA_Redline_v1.pdf for reference.

Thanks,
Kyle Turner
Director, Platform Ops — FastBank


From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>

Kyle —

Appreciate the fast read and the redline. I’ve looped in Monica (support/ops) and Rafael (acct lead) so we can triage and land a clear response. High level: we are comfortable committing to option B (on-call engineering rotation) with an accelerated acknowledgement window for the 48-hour flight-readiness window, pending a short internal runbook update.

Proposed immediate plan:
- Monica to confirm on-call roster and staffing coverage (owner: Monica Patel) — deliverable: written on-call roster + primary/backup contact
- Rafael to coordinate contract amendment and signoff timeline (owner: Rafael Mendes) — deliverable: redlined SLA acceptance memo for FastBank legal
- Michael to run sponsor healthcheck and confirm MAP milestone adjustments (owner: Michael Grant) — deliverable: updated MAP milestones and contingency dates

Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday whether option B is acceptable to FastBank? If yes, we’ll circulate the on-call roster and a targeted runbook for the 48-hour window.

I’ll set a 30-min sync for tomorrow to walk the specifics.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

Sponsor note: Maya Srinivasan has provided the sponsor commitment via internal channel; Lauren please confirm if you want to co-sign. - Publish runbook + rollback checklist (owner: Monica Patel) — 2025-11-05 (done)

- Draft & circulate SLA amendment redline (owner: Rafael Mendes) — 2025-11-14

- Final DocuSign & legal close (owner: Rafael Mendes / FastBank legal) — 2025-11-17
- MAP milestone update & contingency schedule (owner: Michael Grant) — 2025-11-16

- Risk: If sponsor memo misses 2025-11-14, legal will push the go-live out by one sprint (adds 7 business days).
- Mitigation: Rafael to prep amendment language now; Monica to provide phone numbers today if possible.

Thanks all — close coordination will keep the MAP on track.
